subject: Endurance Testing - adding more search functionality testing. (#671)
reason: The change modifies only valkey-search's own integration-test harness: testing/integration/stability_runner.py (new memtier test documents, a different FT.SEARCH query mix for TEXT indexes, consolidated delete/expire memtier commands, and nostem/with_suffix_trie tweaks in the test's index schema) and an assertion message string in testing/integration/stability_test.py. No module source, command, indexing or query code changes, so the module builds at the change and at its parent are behaviorally identical; a compared sequence could mark no expect_difference and a fault scenario would exercise
